hs.f: (medicine, of a biochemical assay) Abbreviation of high-sensitivity.

hsan.f: Initialism of hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy.

hsc.f: (cytology, hematology) Initialism of hematopoietic stem cell.

hsct.f: (medicine) Initialism of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

hsf.f: (computing) Initialism of heat sink and fan.

hsh.l: his serene highness or her serene highness
hsh.f: Initialism of His Serene Highness or Her Serene Highness, the title of a number of members of the royal family in various countries.

s.g: (Taiwan) An administrative subdivision of Taiwan, commonly translated as county. (Alternative form of xian for mainland China.)
s.x: In the hsien, there shall be a hsien government with a hsien magistrate who shall be elected by the people of the hsien.

hsl.f: Initialism of hue, saturation, lightness or initialism of hue, saturation, level.

hsm.f: (military, US) Initialism of Humanitarian Service Medal.

hst.f: (UK, rail transport) Initialism of High Speed Train, a common name for the InterCity 125.

hsts.f: Initialism of homosexual transsexual, a term in Blanchard's discredited transsexualism typology for a trans woman who is attracted to men.
